svg.title: South Fraser Health Region — reversed horizontal logo with Working together for a healthy future, 1998 (vector reconstruction)
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the September 1998 reversed horizontal lockup. Symbol and name: the original 2001 vector outlines of the same artwork, reversed out of a black panel measured from the scan. Tagline: set in Yesteryear (SIL OFL) and converted to outlines as a stand-in for the unidentified original script.
